verses.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
verses.pt: E Davi fugiu de Naiote que é em Ramá, e veio diante de Jônatas, e disse: Que fiz eu? qual é minha maldade, ou qual meu pecado contra teu pai, que ele busca minha vida?
verses.en_web: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”
verses.en_bbe: And David went in flight from Naioth in Ramah and came to Jonathan and said, What have I done? What is my crime and my sin against your father that he is attempting to take my life?

verses.en: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
verses.pt: E ele lhe disse: Em nenhuma maneira; não morrerás. Eis que meu pai nenhuma coisa fará, grande nem pequena, que não a revele a mim; por que pois me encobrirá meu pai este negócio? Não será assim.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Far be the thought: you will not be put to death: see, my father does nothing, great or small, without giving me word of it: would he keep this secret from me? It is not so.

verses.en: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
verses.pt: E Davi voltou a jurar, dizendo: Teu pai sabe claramente que eu achei favor diante de teus olhos, e dirá: Não saiba isto Jônatas, para que não tenha pesar: e certamente, vive o SENHOR e vive tua alma, que apenas há um passo entre mim e a morte.
verses.en_web: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved:’ but truly as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”
verses.en_bbe: But David took his oath again and said, Your father sees that I am dear to you; so he says to himself, Let Jonathan have no idea of this, for it will be a grief to him; but as the Lord is living, and as your soul is living, there is only a step between me and death.

verses.en: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
verses.pt: E Jônatas disse a Davi: Que diga tua alma, e eu o farei por ti?
verses.en_web: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Jonathan said to David, Whatever your desire is, I will do it for you.

verses.en: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
verses.pt: E Davi respondeu a Jônatas: Eis que amanhã será nova lua, e eu costumo sentar-me com o rei a comer: mas tu deixarás que me esconda no campo até à tarde do terceiro dia.
verses.en_web: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.
verses.en_bbe: And David said to Jonathan, Tomorrow is the new moon, and I will not be seated with the king at his table: but let me go to a safe place in the country till the evening.

verses.en: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
verses.pt: Se teu pai fizer menção de mim, dirás: Rogo-me muito que o deixasse ir logo a Belém sua cidade, porque todos os de sua linhagem têm ali sacrifício anual.
verses.en_web: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’
verses.en_bbe: And if your father takes note of the fact that I am away, say, David made a request to me for himself that he might go to Beth-lehem, to his town: for it is the time when his family make their offering year by year.

verses.en: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
verses.pt: Se ele disser, Está bem, teu servo terá paz; mas se se irar, sabe que a malícia está nele completa.
verses.en_web: If he says, ‘It is well;’ your servant shall have peace: but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.
verses.en_bbe: If he says, It is well, your servant will be at peace: but if he is angry, then it will be clear to you that he has an evil purpose in mind against me.

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
verses.pt: Farás, pois, misericórdia com teu servo, já que trouxeste teu servo a aliança do SENHOR contigo: e se maldade há em mim mata-me tu, que não há necessidade de levar-me até teu pai.
verses.en_web: Therefore deal kindly with your servant; for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself; for why should you bring me to your father?”
verses.en_bbe: So, then, be kind to your servant; for you have been united with your servant in an agreement made before the Lord: but if there is any wrongdoing in me, put me to death yourself; why take me to your father?

verses.en: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
verses.pt: E Jônatas lhe disse: Nunca tal te suceda; antes bem, se eu entendesse ser completa a malícia de meu pai, para vir sobre ti, não havia eu de revelá-lo a ti?
verses.en_web: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan said, Do not have such a thought: for if I saw that my father was designing evil against you, would I not give you word of it?

verses.en: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
verses.pt: Disse então Davi a Jônatas: Quem me dará aviso? Ou que se teu pai te responder asperamente?
verses.en_web: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”
verses.en_bbe: Then David said to Jonathan, Who will give me word if your father gives you a rough answer?

verses.en: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
verses.pt: E Jônatas disse a Davi: Vem, saiamos ao campo. E saíram ambos ao campo.
verses.en_web: Jonathan said to David, “Come, and let us go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan said to David, Come, let us go out into the country. And the two of them went out together into the open country.

verses.en: And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
verses.pt: Então disse Jônatas a Davi: Ó SENHOR Deus de Israel, quando houver eu perguntado a meu pai amanhã a esta hora, ou depois de amanhã, e ele parecer bem para com Davi, se então não enviar a ti, e o revelar a ti,
verses.en_web: Jonathan said to David, “By Yahweh, the God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you, and disclose it to you?
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan said to David, May the Lord, the God of Israel, be witness; when I have had a chance of talking to my father, about this time tomorrow, if his feelings to David are good, will I not send and give you the news?

verses.en: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
verses.pt: O SENHOR faça assim a Jônatas, e isto acrescente. Mas se a meu pai parecer bem fazer-te mal, também te o revelarei, e te enviarei, e te irás em paz: e seja o SENHOR contigo, como foi com meu pai.
verses.en_web: Yahweh do so to Jonathan, and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you, and send you away, that you may go in peace. May Yahweh be with you, as he has been with my father.
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord's punishment be on Jonathan, if it is my father's pleasure to do you evil and I do not give you word of it and send you away so that you may go in peace: and may the Lord be with you, as he has been with my father.

verses.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:
verses.pt: E se eu viver, farás comigo misericórdia do SENHOR; mas se for morto,
verses.en_web: You shall not only while yet I live show me the loving kindness of Yahweh, that I not die;
verses.en_bbe: And may you, while I am still living, O may you be kind to me, as the Lord is kind, and keep me from death!

verses.en: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.pt: Não tirarás perpetuamente tua misericórdia de minha casa, nem quando o SENHOR exterminar um por um os inimigos de Davi da face da terra.
verses.en_web: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever; no, not when Yahweh has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And let not your mercy ever be cut off from my family, even when the Lord has sent destruction on all David's haters, cutting them off from the face of the earth.

verses.en: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.
verses.pt: Assim Jônatas fez aliança com a casa de Davi, dizendo: O SENHOR o exija da mão dos inimigos de Davi.
verses.en_web: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “Yahweh will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”
verses.en_bbe: And if it comes about that the name of Jonathan is cut off from the family of David, the Lord will make David responsible.

verses.en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.pt: E voltou Jônatas a jurar a Davi, porque o amava, porque o amava como à sua alma.
verses.en_web: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had to him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan again took an oath to David, because of his love for him: for David was as dear to him as his very soul.

verses.en: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe logo Jônatas: Amanhã é lua nova, e tua falta será percebida, porque teu assento estará vazio.
verses.en_web: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jonathan said to him, Tomorrow is the new moon: and it will be seen that you are not present, for there will be no one in your seat.

verses.en: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.pt: Estarás, pois, três dias, e logo descerás, e virás ao lugar de onde estavas escondido o dia do incidente, e esperarás junto à pedra de Ezel;
verses.en_web: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly, and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.en_bbe: And on the third day it will be specially noted, and you will go to the place where you took cover when the other business was in hand, waiting by the hill over there.

verses.en: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.pt: E eu atirarei três flechas até aquele lado, como que me exercitando ao alvo.
verses.en_web: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.en_bbe: And on the third day I will send arrows from my bow against its side as if at a mark.

verses.en: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.
verses.pt: E logo enviarei o criado dizendo-lhe: Vai, busca as flechas. E se disser ao jovem: Eis ali as flechas mais aqui de ti, toma-as: tu virás, porque tens paz, e nada há de mal, vive o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come; for there is peace to you and no danger, as Yahweh lives.
verses.en_bbe: And I will send my boy to have a look for the arrow. And if I say to him, See, the arrow is on this side of you; take it up! then you may come; for there is peace for you and no evil, by the living Lord.

verses.en: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.
verses.pt: Mas se eu disser ao jovem assim: Eis ali as flechas mais ali de ti: vai-te, porque o SENHOR te enviou.
verses.en_web: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you;’ then go your way; for Yahweh has sent you away.
verses.en_bbe: But if I say to the boy, See, the arrow has gone past you: then go on your way, for the Lord has sent you away.

verses.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.
verses.pt: E quanto às palavras que eu e tu falamos, seja o SENHOR entre mim e ti para sempre.
verses.en_web: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, Yahweh is between you and me forever.”
verses.en_bbe: As for what you and I were talking of, the Lord is between you and me for ever.

verses.en: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
verses.pt: Então Davi se escondeu no campo, e vinda que foi a lua nova, sentou-se o rei a comer pão.
verses.en_web: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.
verses.en_bbe: So David went to a secret place in the country: and when the new moon came, the king took his place at the feast.

verses.en: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.
verses.pt: E o rei se sentou em sua cadeira, como costumava, no assento junto à parede, e Jônatas se levantou, e sentou-se Abner ao lado de Saul, e o lugar de Davi estava vazio.
verses.en_web: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
verses.en_bbe: And the king took his seat, as at other times, by the wall: and Jonathan was in front, and Abner was seated by Saul's side, but there was no one in David's seat.

verses.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.pt: Mas aquele dia Saul não disse nada, porque se dizia: Haverá lhe acontecido algo, e não está limpo; não estará purificado.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”
verses.en_bbe: But Saul said nothing that day, for his thought was, Something has taken place making him unclean; it is clear that he is not clean.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
verses.pt: O dia seguinte, o segundo dia da lua nova, aconteceu também que o assento de Davi estava vazio. E Saul disse a Jônatas seu filho: Por que não veio a comer o filho de Jessé hoje nem ontem?
verses.en_web: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why doesn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”
verses.en_bbe: And on the day after the new moon, that is, the second day, there was still no one in David's seat: and Saul said to his son Jonathan, Why has the son of Jesse not come to the feast yesterday or today?

verses.en: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:
verses.pt: E Jônatas respondeu a Saul: Davi me pediu encarecidamente lhe deixasse ir até Belém.
verses.en_web: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.
verses.en_bbe: And answering Saul, Jonathan said, He made a request to me that he might go to Beth-lehem,

verses.en: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.
verses.pt: E disse: Rogo-te que me deixes ir, porque temos sacrifício os de nossa linhagem na cidade, e meu irmão mesmo me mandou; portanto, se achei graça em teus olhos, farei uma escapada agora, e visitarei a meus irmãos. Por isto, pois, não veio.
verses.en_web: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Our family is making an offering in the town, and my brothers have given me orders to be there: so now, if I have grace in your eyes, let me go away and see my brothers. This is why he has not come to the king's table.

verses.en: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?
verses.pt: Então Saul se acendeu contra Jônatas, e disse-lhe: Filho da pervertida e rebelde! Não sei eu que tu escolheste ao filho de Jessé para vergonha tua, e para vergonha da nudez de tua mãe?
verses.en_web: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
verses.en_bbe: Then Saul was moved to wrath against Jonathan, and he said to him, You son of an evil and uncontrolled woman, have I not seen how you have given your love to the son of Jesse, to your shame and the shame of your mother?

verses.en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.pt: Porque todo o tempo que o filho de Jessé viver sobre a terra, nem tu serás firme, nem teu reino. Envia, pois, agora, e traze-o a mim, porque morrerá.
verses.en_web: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”
verses.en_bbe: For while the son of Jesse is living on the earth, your position is unsafe and your kingdom is in danger. So make him come here to me, for it is certainly right for him to be put to death.

verses.en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
verses.pt: E Jônatas respondeu a seu pai Saul, e disse-lhe: Por que morrerá? O que ele fez?
verses.en_web: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan, answering his father Saul, said to him, Why is he to be put to death? What has he done?

verses.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
verses.pt: Então Saul lhe lançou uma lança para feri-lo: de onde entendeu Jônatas que seu pai estava determinado a matar a Davi.
verses.en_web: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul, pointing his spear at him, made an attempt to give him a wound: from which it was clear to Jonathan that his father's purpose was to put David to death.

verses.en: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.pt: E levantou-se Jônatas da mesa com exaltada ira, e não comeu pão o segundo dia da lua nova: porque tinha dor por causa de Davi, porque seu pai lhe havia afrontado.
verses.en_web: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.
verses.en_bbe: So Jonathan got up from the table, burning with wrath, and took no part in the feast the second day of the month, being full of grief for David because his father had put shame on him.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.pt: Ao outro dia de manhã, saiu Jônatas ao campo, ao tempo marcado com Davi, e um jovem pequeno com ele.
verses.en_web: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.
verses.en_bbe: Now in the morning, Jonathan went out into the fields at the time he had said to David, and he had a little boy with him.

verses.en: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.pt: E disse a seu jovem: Corre e busca as flechas que eu atirar. E quando o jovem ia correndo, ele atirava a flecha que passava mais além dele.
verses.en_web: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the boy, Go and get the arrow I let loose from my bow. And while the boy was running, he sent an arrow past him.

verses.en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
verses.pt: E chegando o jovem onde estava a flecha que Jônatas havia atirado, Jônatas deu vozes atrás o jovem, dizendo: Não está a flecha mais além de ti?
verses.en_web: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”
verses.en_bbe: And when the boy came to the place where the arrow was, Jonathan, crying out after the boy, said, Has it not gone past you?

verses.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.pt: E voltou a gritar Jônatas atrás o jovem: Apressa-te, corre, não pares. E o jovem de Jônatas agarrou as flechas, e veio a seu senhor.
verses.en_web: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan went on crying out after the boy, Be quick, do not keep waiting about, go quickly. And Jonathan's boy got the arrow and came back to his master.

verses.en: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.pt: Porém nenhuma coisa entendeu o jovem: somente Jônatas e Davi entendiam o negócio.
verses.en_web: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.en_bbe: But the boy had no idea what was going on; only Jonathan and David had knowledge of it.

verses.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.pt: Logo deu Jônatas suas armas a seu jovem, e disse-lhe: Vai-te e leva-as à cidade.
verses.en_web: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan gave his bow and arrows to the boy, and said to him, Take these and go back to the town.

verses.en: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.pt: E logo que o jovem se havia ido, se levantou Davi da parte do sul, e inclinou-se três vezes prostrando-se até a terra: e beijando-se o um ao outro, choraram o um com o outro, ainda que Davi chorou mais.
verses.en_web: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another, and wept one with another, and David wept the most.
verses.en_bbe: And when the boy had gone, David came from his secret place by the hill, and falling to the earth went down on his face three times: and they gave one another a kiss, weeping together, till David's grief was the greater.

verses.en: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.pt: E Jônatas disse a Davi: Vai-te em paz, que ambos juramos pelo nome do SENHOR, dizendo: o SENHOR seja entre mim e ti, entre minha descendência e a tua descendência para sempre.
verses.en_web: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘Yahweh is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, for we two have taken an oath, in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord will be between me and you, and between my seed and your seed for ever. Then David went away, and Jonathan went into the town.
